7.1.10.2 SetTraceStatus
[SWS_Dlt_00703] ⌈If the Dlt command Dlt_SetTraceStatus is requested, the
new trace status shall be stored for the received tuple of DltSwcApplicationId/
DltSwcContextId.⌋()
[SWS_Dlt_00704] ⌈If the Dlt command Dlt_SetTraceStatus is requested, but the
addressed tuple of DltSwcApplicationId/DltSwcContextId is unknown, the Dlt
command shall be answered with DLT_E_ERROR.⌋()
caption: 7.1.10.2 SetTraceStatus
